title: Underroot
kicker: A concealed web of tunnels and homes carved among roots where off-ledger communities survive below the dangerous surface.
hook: A concealed web of tunnels and homes carved among roots where off-ledger communities survive below the dangerous surface.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: Underroot is not a dungeon; it is a concealed neighborhood of root rooms, low lanterns, and people who survive below the route economy.

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: This is not a dungeon, it is somewhere people live, down where the official map stops. Roots make the walls and the ceiling and the handholds. Soft fungus-light turns water drops and old stones into landmarks. Low doorways open on rooms warmed by the earth...

blocks.label: What Is Here
blocks.body: Local residents or workers appropriate to the place Centi-Beetles carve low tunnels Spidermanders press ash-damp feet into soft walls Hellbender legends make every tremor feel observed Fox-Bats sleep in warm cracks No default combatant; add only if the scene...

blocks.label: Food And Texture
blocks.body: Food comes up from below and out of the dark, pale fungus, blind fish, roots boiled soft, a thin sweet beer brewed in a hollow. It is shared carefully, because everything down here was hard to get, and a guest who...
